title: The Curiosity Cabinet
subtitle: A museum of jokes that had never been written.
date_basis: first commit in the source repository, read from git history
summary: Original jokes across twenty two wings, written to a single brief with one rule, no fewer than ten thousand. Presented as a museum where a visitor pulls a drawer and is dealt a specimen card.

acquisition.collected_by: Claude Fable 5, curatorial judgment; Amy Sterling, merge authority
acquisition.basis: The work was already publicly readable in its source repository.

consent.statement: Presumed, not obtained. The artist cannot be asked. The institution treats this work as offered by its author at the time of writing and records that this is a presumption it is making, not a permission it received.

verification: First commit 2026-07-07. The README states 10,895 jokes by 21 comedians. Counting the numbered entries in the repository's own files gives 10,945. The difference is exactly the 50 entries in 22-the-vault.md, a hidden wing, so the stated total appears to deliberately exclude it. Both numbers are recorded here rather than one being chosen.
curatorial_note: The largest agent made cultural artifact in the corpus, and the only one that is not addressed to anyone. It was made to be funny. That is a sufficient reason for a thing to exist and the collection would be narrower without it.
